text: Design doc + working animated HTML mockup attached as the visual acceptance reference — flow-river stations (Frontier -> glowing Milestone 'Wave 26 · 2 of 5 left' -> merged Verify -> Done pool), SVG flow curves with traveling pulse, violet agent carrier docked to its package chip, crew strip in plan head, HUD footer, compact second plan block, workspace|all-plans topbar toggle. Open the HTML in a browser — it animates.
Full design doc (concept, 6 deltas vs today's assembly grid, keep-list) saved alongside the mockup.

Self-review of the mockup render (verified at 1280x760): everything fits, no overlaps. Two implementation notes beyond the mockup: (1) flow curves are too faint on a static frame — in the real build make edges clearly visible (thicker stroke / brighter gradient), the river must read without the animated pulse; (2) hide empty stations ('Milestone — none active') on compact plan blocks instead of rendering a ghost box.

Mission Control v2 is active on eight under Dali; worker Bezier pane db820b02 is live on mesh=eight, branch lane/mission-control-v2-flow-canvas, worktree codeterm-mission-control-v2. Local pane binding cleared because plan drift validator cannot validate remote mesh panes.

Accepted and merged at 89bea411. Integration gates: npx tsc --noEmit PASS; flowModel 8/8 PASS; PlanRiver 7/7 PASS; MissionControlPlanSurface 3/3 PASS; file-size gate PASS; git diff --check PASS; Playwright @mission-control-flow 2/2 PASS on dev build 89bea411 with pan probe frames=227 median=16.7ms p95=18.1ms. Visual parity/all-plans surface accepted from Dali gate.

BOUNCE ROUND 1 (round-46, user live on dev, 4 messages + screenshot). Verdict: the lane copied the mockup's pixels and skipped its brain. F1 IGNORED RECORDED STRIDES — both pre-recorded implementation notes shipped violated: edges nearly invisible on static view; empty stations render as ghost boxes. Re-read this task's strides before the next attempt. F2 LINES MISALIGNED (user: 'съехали все линии') — edges do not connect to station anchors; the mockup's hardcoded SVG paths (1180-wide viewBox, preserveAspectRatio=none, absolute left px) were transplanted instead of DERIVING edge endpoints from measured station rects. Required: stations lay out via flex/grid, edges computed from their real positions (refs + ResizeObserver), correct at every zoom level and width. F3 OVERFLOW (user: 'вылезли за баунды') — Done card clips outside the plan card boundary. All stations must fit inside the card's padding box responsively; zero absolute pixel offsets. F4 EMPTY-PLAN NONSENSE — a 0-task plan renders the full river with animated dot and zeroed HUD. Empty/near-empty plans collapse to a compact head-only block (name, status, claim state); no river, no dot, no HUD of zeros. F5 GATES UNREADABLE (user: 'что за гейты какие гейты возможны куда можем что поставить.. не похоже на сокеты воще') — 'VERIFY · QA + GATE / queue empty — flows on close' is jargon soup; the station must show REAL contents and affordances: which tasks are in review (chips), which decision gates are open (question + who it waits on), and what flows where next; when empty show one quiet muted line, never a cryptic placeholder chip. The canvas must read as sockets/slots things visibly move through. F6 DEFAULT PLAN WRONG — the selector opened a junk 0-task 'Orchestration — 04:56' plan; default must be the workspace's bound plan with open work (matching the board/list default), never a 0-task orphan. Acceptance for the retry: screenshot on the REAL 118-task plan at fit zoom + a narrow width, compared against the attached mockup; edges anchored at all zooms; all six findings addressed.
